title: review-run cancel --json
description: The run after cancel (state failed, reason canceled, exit_code 143), unchanged for a terminal run, a run finalized by the refresh or a dry run, or still running with cancel_requested_at set when a live runner had not ended it after 120 s.

changed.description: false for a run that was already terminal or ended by the refresh, a run in phase finalize, and a dry run; true from the recording of the cancellation on.

action.description: none (terminal, or nothing to act on), stop (agent-spawn stop of an agent that is not parked), signal_runner (SIGTERM to the verified live runner when no agent exists) or signal_launcher (SIGTERM to the verified live agent-spawn launcher when no agent id and no runner exist).

warnings.description: The run's own warnings after the command (any code of the run warning list).
